data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting loss of GBP 47,520k (2017: GBP 16,095k) is analysed below by year of account. Underwriting result by year of account: 2017: 27,903; 2016: 1,223. During the financial year the 2015 underwriting year closed and the final amount settled to members was GBP 13,257k.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2008 to 2015 years of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate concluded an external reinsurance to close of the 2008 to 2015 years of account as at 31 December 2017, which contributed to a release of reserves and fall in the 2017 claims ratio. The 2015 underwriting year closed with a loss of GBP 13,257k.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 15.869 million in prior year reserves for the 2018 financial year, representing 2.69% of opening gross claims outstanding. This mixed development includes profits (releases) of GBP 27.903 million for the 2017 year of account and GBP 1.223 million for the 2016 year of account. However, the 2015 and prior years of account closed with a loss of GBP 13.257 million, indicating adverse development (strengthening) for those older years. The external reinsurance to close (RITC) of the 2008 to 2015 years of account, concluded as at 31 December 2017, contributed to a release of reserves and a fall in the 2017 claims ratio.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 18 is not used for the primary PYD calculation due to the distortion from the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2015 and prior years of account, which effectively removed older years from the syndicate's books. The PYD is instead derived from the explicit year-of-account results and closure statements.
